create_grasp_manager: create a RearrangeGraspManager instance to manage agent grasping onto rigid and articulated objects in the simulator
snap_to_obj: snap a rigid object to the robot end effector using fixed constraints and collision group overrides
snap_to_marker: snap the end effector to a named marker on an articulated object using point-to-point constraints
desnap_object: release a grasped object by removing hold constraints and optionally resetting its collision group immediately
check_hold_violation: check if the grasped object has drifted too far from the end effector exceeding the hold threshold
